deferred_or_rejected.reason: The raw CIF is ordered fluoriteUO2 with a5.512A and explicit993K, cited to a beta-uranium powder study. Full primary text and oxide-phase measurement context have not been independently checked. This may be a legitimate high-temperature reference, but is not silently promoted as room-temperatureUO2. Other exact-UO2 COD hits are a1951 age/uraninite study and1963 secondary compilation; neither resolves the requested primary experimental source under this bounded search.

ElementalOs candidates include a theoretical fcc record, natural iridium-osmium mineral context,1937 lattice values with unresolved historical calibration,1963 secondary compilation,and1998 mineral paper attribution. An unmodified experimental rutileOsO2 record with a directly traceable1971 table was selected instead; no lattice rescaling or elemental substitution.
Available TlI records are1936 or a1963 compilation. Prefer the later experimental Tl2O3 structure with traceable DOI and both independentTl sites.

A modern298K elementalBi single-crystal structure with original full refinement CIF was selected. Disordered delta/gamma oxides are outside the ordered-source recipe; no oxygen-vacancy occupancy was filled.

source_quality_notes: Missing diffractiontemperature/pressure remainnull. Cellconditions are not inferred from crystal-growth/calcination conditions.
No experimental XAS validation, SCF convergence, cluster-radius sensitivity or next-edge suitability is established by this source-only work.
Bi uses an explicitly described3+3 near-neighbor envelope, preserving short intrabilayer and longer interbilayer distances separately, not six equivalent bonds.
Tl2O3 includes every independentTl absorber:8b weight0.25 and24d weight0.75. FEFF degeneracy remains per absorbing atom; weights are not multiplied into individualCN.
OriginalCOD text and notice preserved byte-for-byte. COD9007542 is an explicit1971 compilation of Boman1970 experimentalOsO2 data; provenance does not claim this is an original1970 depositedCIF.
ThO2 frozen-f atomic treatment does not validate charge transfer or chemicalTh(IV); nativecontrols must be recorded by the runner.

native_f_caveat.verified_statement: Official FEFF8.4 documentation says atomic f density is frozen by default; UNFREEZEF changes f-DOS self-consistency. This does not substitute for checking the actual Feff8L native controls.
native_f_caveat.action: Keep the agreed recipe unchanged. Preserve native iunf/ihole/rfms/mix proof and candidate warnings; do not auto-promote actinide paths.

sources-alkali-halide.rationale: Independent experimental nitrate and molecular-iodine references selected after binary halide searches did not yield comparably traceable primary data. No generic ideal salt structure, element substitution or manually adjusted coordinate was used.
